question: Who among the following is the author of the book Kitab-ul-Hind?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Al -beruni__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kitab-ul-Hind was written by Al-Biruni. **
 
• It is a famous Arabic text wherein he comments on Indian Sciences, Hindu religious beliefs, customs, and Social organization. 
 
• **Al-Biruni**** **was the First Muslim Scholar to study India and its Brahmanical tradition. 
 
• **He is called the father of Indology and the first anthropologist**. 
 
• He is called one of the earliest and greatest polymaths of the Islamic World. 
 
• Alberuni in his book Kitab-ul-Hind appreciated a very high degree of proficiency of Indians in the construction of Tanks and reservoirs at holy places.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ibn Battuta** 

 
 
• Ibn Battuta was a Muslim Moroccan scholar.
 
• Ibn Batuta's book name is Rihia that is written in Arabic, provides extremely rich and interesting details about the social and cultural life in the subcontinent in the **fourteenth century.**
 
 
 
• Al-Masudi
 
 
• Al Masudi an Arab explorer from Baghdad, gave an account of the reversal of ocean currents and the monsoon winds over the north Indian plain.
 
• Al-Masudi was an Arab historian, geographer, and traveler. He is sometimes referred to as the "Herodotus of the Arabs".
